references.text: Here reference is made to the creation of man and woman and their union into one flesh as the foundation for marriage.
Jesus quotes this verse from Genesis to emphasize the indivisible nature of marriage.
Paul uses the principle of 'one flesh' in his argument against sexual immorality, especially in connection with prostitutes.
Paul quotes this verse in his teaching on the relationship between husbands and wives, comparing it to Christ and the church.
